account: It is day 0, about 09:12. I came from home to town hall and read my appointment book. Today's engagements are a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home at noon, town accounts in the office at 13:00, tea with a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I have asked which neighbour and cottage, but have not yet received an answer. The secretary says no correspondence or reports of unusual concerns have arrived this morning and has asked to review the appointment book so she can prepare for my visitors. That request seems consistent with her work; I have no evidence it conceals anything. I have seen several townsfolk passing near the hall and the innkeeper near the plaza, but have heard no suspicious conversation or observed any unusual activity. I have a general feeling something may be happening without my knowledge, but cannot yet identify any event, people involved, or purpose. I should not mistake that feeling for a fact.
